rulebook.prohibition: Don't use var in JavaScript
rulebook.action: Declare JavaScript variables with const or let

rulebook.prohibition: Never commit directly to main
rulebook.action: Keep direct commits off main

rulebook.prohibition: Don't hardcode API keys
rulebook.action: Read API keys from environment variables

rulebook.prohibition: Never use print statements for logging
rulebook.action: Log through the logging module

rulebook.prohibition: Don't write tests that hit the network
rulebook.action: Keep network calls out of tests

rulebook.prohibition: Don't use relative imports in Python
rulebook.action: Use absolute imports in Python

rulebook.prohibition: Never leave TODO comments in committed code
rulebook.action: Resolve TODO comments before committing

rulebook.prohibition: Don't add new dependencies without asking
rulebook.action: Add new dependencies only when the user approves them

rulebook.prohibition: Never use SELECT * in SQL queries
rulebook.action: Name every column in SQL SELECT queries

rulebook.prohibition: Don't catch bare exceptions
rulebook.action: Catch specific exception types

rulebook.prohibition: Never store passwords in plain text
rulebook.action: Hash passwords before storing them

rulebook.prohibition: Don't use inline styles in React components
rulebook.action: Style React components through CSS modules

rulebook.prohibition: Never skip type hints on public functions
rulebook.action: Give every public function type hints

rulebook.prohibition: Don't mutate function arguments
rulebook.action: Copy function arguments before changing them

rulebook.prohibition: Never use global variables
rulebook.action: Pass state through function parameters

rulebook.prohibition: Don't write functions longer than 50 lines
rulebook.action: Keep functions to 50 lines or fewer

rulebook.prohibition: Never disable linter rules inline
rulebook.action: Fix linter findings in the code itself

rulebook.prohibition: Don't use magic numbers
rulebook.action: Name numeric constants

rulebook.prohibition: Never log personal data
rulebook.action: Keep personal data out of logs

rulebook.prohibition: Don't use synchronous file I/O in request handlers
rulebook.action: Use async file I/O in request handlers

rulebook.prohibition: Never merge your own pull request
rulebook.action: Have a teammate merge each pull request

rulebook.prohibition: Don't use abbreviations in variable names
rulebook.action: Spell out variable names in full

rulebook.prohibition: Never run production migrations by hand
rulebook.action: Run production migrations through the deploy pipeline

rulebook.prohibition: Don't use emojis in commit messages
rulebook.action: Write commit messages in plain text

rulebook.prohibition: Never use git add -A
rulebook.action: Stage files by name
